dedupe_keys.name: tdengine time series database and industrial data platform

description: TDengine is a time-series database and industrial data platform offered as an alternative to traditional data historians such as the AVEVA PI System. It collects and stores high-volume sensor data, adds asset models through an industrial ontology, and provides visualisation, events, calculations, reporting and AI agents for anomaly detection and root cause analysis; the vendor claims more than ten times the performance of general-purpose databases and up to 90% lower storage costs. It is developed by the TDengine company, which says over 1,000 industrial firms use it. Coverage is global. The core, TDengine TSDB-OSS, is fully open source and underlies the paid offerings, and the full platform is free for up to 5,000 tags; it runs in the public cloud, on premises or at the edge and connects through a REST API, JDBC, ODBC, Kafka, MQTT and an Excel add-in. Caveats: performance figures are vendor claims, and the home page does not name the open-source licence. For simulation it stores and serves live plant and grid sensor streams on which digital twins, anomaly detection and resilience analyses of industrial sites can be built. It is related to the AVEVA PI System record in this catalogue, the historian it aims to replace.
